//: Committed project settings. The unattended scheduled tasks (docs/knowledge/12 + 13) run headless with --permission-mode default, so ANY tool missing from this allowlist is refused mid-run with nobody there to approve it. These permissions are what the automation needs to function, not a machine preference — that is why they live here and not in the gitignored settings.local.json. See 05-decisions.md D13, failure mode 2.
//playwright: The mcp__playwright__* entries are for form-filling on EXTERNAL ATS sites (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workday) - never LinkedIn, which has its own server and its own browser profile. Deliberately EXCLUDED from the allowlist: browser_run_code_unsafe and browser_evaluate (both execute arbitrary JS in page context), plus browser_drop and browser_handle_dialog. Those are not blocked - they just cost a human approval per call, which is the point. NOTE: there is no 'submit' tool; submitting a form IS a browser_click, so fills-never-submits is a rule in the runbook, NOT something this allowlist can enforce.
//write: Write + Edit added 2026-07-30. Without them a headless run could read and reason but not record: the 19:16 reply-check finished successfully and then had to ASK for three writes it could not make, so its log line, the 07-current-state update and the graphify session line were all lost. Every unattended run was discarding its own findings. Scope is the project directory; the runbooks are what keep a run from writing outside its remit.
